examples.title: See what that query actually counts
Express eligibility with EXISTS
examples.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS qualifying_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotions p WHERE p.region = o.region);

challenge.title: Count eligible orders by region
challenge.prompt: Return region and qualifying_orders for paid orders with at least one regional campaign. Count each order once.
challenge.hint: Use EXISTS or a semijoin for eligibility. Group the order records, not repeated campaign matches.
challenge.starter:
SELECT o.region, count(*) AS qualifying_orders
FROM orders o JOIN promotions p ON o.region = p.region
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region;
challenge.solution:
SELECT o.region, count(*) AS qualifying_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotions p WHERE p.region = o.region)
GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region;
challenge.success: Each region has 2,000 qualifying orders. Multiple campaigns no longer multiply the order count.
